title: DCP Cyclic-Group QFT_{2^m} Dihedral Coset Interference Bridge
claims: Cyclic QFT_{2^m}^dagger on an m-wire product phase state yields the exact product distribution prod_{j=0}^{m-1} cos^2(theta_j/2 - pi*K/2^{m-j}).
Achieves probability 1.0 at K_0 iff theta_j == 2*pi*2^j*K_0/2^m (mod 2*pi) for all j.
